title: Exercise fitting before checking ScoringMonitor garbage collection
answers: How do I test that a scoring monitor releases its listener?
Why can a callback cleanup test miss a signature-cache leak?
How do I reproduce scoring monitor resources surviving callback deletion?
body:
ScoringMonitor cleanup tests must exercise fitting before checking collection, because fitting triggers callback signature caching.
In sklearn/callback/tests/test_scoring_monitor.py:test_scoring_monitor_listener_closed_on_gc, fit a temporary estimator with the callback, delete the callback, and call gc.collect().
Verify that the listener address disappears from both _listeners and _message_consumers; checking only construction and deletion misses retention introduced during fitting.
applies: Regression tests for ScoringMonitor listener cleanup after callback use.
